name: termux_download
params: url:string:下载地址|out:string:保存文件名(可空)
cmd: sh /data/adb/lemon_kernel/lemon/dedup/run.sh termux_download export PREFIX=/data/data/com.termux/files/usr; export PATH=$PREFIX/bin:/system/bin; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$PREFIX/lib; export TMPDIR=$PREFIX/tmp; export HOME=/data/data/com.termux/files/home; cd $HOME; o=$out; if [ -z "$o" ]; then o=download.bin; fi; curl -L -m 280 -o "$o" $url && echo DOWNLOADED && ls -l "$o"
